summary_text: In April 2026, one order of Tide Naturals Lemon and Chandan Detergent Powder (3 kg) was placed on a weekday evening. This timing aligns with the population baseline where evening (0.3027) is a high-share period, comparable to morning (0.3246). The product is a standard laundry detergent powder intended for general stain removal and cleaning of daily wear. As this is a single observation on one date, it is not yet established whether this represents a stable brand preference, a specific scent preference, or a one-time replenishment need.
